title: Today's Line is ready
body: Same map for everyone. One minute to set your score.

title: A fresh route just opened
body: Today's Daily Line takes about 60 seconds. Your streak: {streak_days} days.

title: The 8:00 departs on time
body: One board. Every player. Sixty seconds. Show us your route.

title: Your {streak_days}-day line is still open
body: Complete today's route before midnight to keep the badge. Campaign progress is safe either way.

title: One route keeps the streak
body: Today's Daily Line is quick — about a minute. Your {streak_days}-day badge is waiting.

title: Last departure of the day
body: The Daily Line closes at midnight. One minute keeps your {streak_days}-day streak rolling.

title: Platform {last_fail_level} is calmer now
body: That route was retuned. Your next attempt starts with a clearer preview.

title: The cats held your spot
body: District {district} is where you left it. A free rewind is waiting on your next run.

title: New tip for Level {last_fail_level}
body: Watch the {hint_color} source first — it sets the rhythm for the whole board.

title: A new district opened
body: Three new routes and a free daily rewind are ready. No timer — come back when you have a minute.

title: The metro kept running
body: New routes were added while you were away. Your progress and cosmetics are exactly as you left them.

title: Your conductor cat got promoted
body: There's a new badge and fresh routes in {district}. One-minute sessions whenever you're ready.

title: One route when you have a minute
body: We added new levels and retuned the tricky ones. If Cat Metro isn't for you, no more reminders after this.

title: Last call from the depot
body: New content is live. This is our final reminder — thanks for riding with us either way.

title: The 14-day special
body: A free premium-theme trial is waiting on your next session. Final reminder from us.

title: {event_name} is live
body: Night routes all week with an earnable conductor badge. Runs through Sunday.

title: New this week: {event_name}
body: Three special routes and a badge for finishing them. No purchase needed.

title: The night shift begins
body: {event_name}: same one-thumb routes with a twist. Ends Sunday night.

title: {event_name} ends tonight
body: You've finished {progress} of {total} routes. One more earns the participation livery.

title: Last night for {event_name}
body: Your badge progress: {progress}/{total}. About two minutes to finish.

title: A route tip for Level {level_id}
body: Watch the {hint_color} source first. Your next run includes one free rewind.

title: Level {level_id} was retuned
body: We adjusted the preview timing based on player data. Fresh eyes and a free rewind might do it.

title: Stuck is normal here
body: {fail_pct}% of players need 3+ tries on Level {level_id}. Your free rewind is loaded.

title: Your All Access is live everywhere
body: Themes and the bonus district are unlocked on this device. Restore works on any phone with your account.

title: Thanks for supporting a fair game
body: All Access unlocked: bonus district + both themes + daily rewind. No ads will interrupt your runs.

title: Your purchase didn't complete
body: No charge went through. If you still want All Access it's waiting in the shop — no rush.

title: Payment didn't finish
body: The store reported an incomplete purchase and you were not charged. Tap Restore if you think this is wrong.

title: Help tune the next district
body: Three quick questions about difficulty. No rating prompt and you can skip.

title: You've played {levels_done} routes
body: That makes you exactly who we want feedback from. Three questions - 30 seconds.

title: {pack_name} just arrived
body: New routes are live. Your daily rewind refreshed too.

title: Fresh tracks laid overnight
body: {pack_name} is ready to play. Same one-thumb rules with new twists.
